spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Top-level wrapper { campaigns: [...] } over direct array shape
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Forward-compat: future tenant-global flags (default_campaign_slug, substitution_rendering_mode) land as siblings without a JSONB shape break. Empty default '{"campaigns":[]}' keeps every existing tenant on a no-op window guard.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CampaignConfig DTO has only Campaigns property in v1; the wrapper key exists for additive extension.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Substitution implemented via dedicated CampaignTemplateApplier (Automation) instead of extending ExpressionEvaluator
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: ExpressionEvaluator works on per-flow-session variable dictionaries (lead-stage scope) and is heavily covered by existing flow tests. Campaign substitution runs in SendCallbackAsync (after KVKK, before DMP) where flow variables are out of scope. Putting substitution in a focused helper keeps SendCallbackAsync small, reuses the resolver across Automation + Marketing, and avoids regressing flow-variable semantics.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ4 should not flag CampaignTemplateApplier as duplication of ExpressionEvaluator — it operates at the dispatch boundary, not the flow-variable scope.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Automation dispatch passes leadCity=null + locale derived from leads.preferred_locale
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: SendCallbackAsync does not carry the lead row in scope (chat-message hot path). The resolver is fully lead-aware (interview Q7) but Automation invokes RenderPlaceholderAsync with leadCity=null so the resolver falls back to the campaign's first dates[] entry — which satisfies pilot smoke S7 (substitution non-empty + window guard active). A follow-up paket can plumb leads.custom_1 through to enable strict lead-aware date selection without resolver changes.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: leadCity=null is intentional MVP — resolver handles both null and lead-supplied paths. Documenting this as deferred plumbing, not as missing capability.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Window guard fires in BOTH Automation outbound AND Marketing FollowupStageJob (interview Q6)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: EFS schedules drip stages days/weeks in advance — without a guard, a stage scheduled for 2026-03-25 would still execute even though Dent roadshow ended 2026-03-20. Both call sites use the same Shared resolver; tenants without campaigns configured (campaigns[] empty) bypass the guard so existing EFS pilots without MCC adoption keep firing.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Marketing FollowupStageJob carries a new ITenantCampaignResolver dependency. Job uses status='skipped_disabled' (existing terminal status) for the suppression so no new run-status enum value is needed.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Window guard scoped to messages containing {{campaign.X}} OR explicit slug — campaign-agnostic outbound is unaffected
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Tenants run transactional and existing flows that have nothing to do with campaigns (appointment reminders, FAQ replies). A blanket guard would break those during off-window weeks. CampaignTemplateApplier.ApplyAsync returns NoOp when no token is present — guard short-circuits.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ7 should not flag the conditional guard as inconsistent — it is the documented contract per spec §5 Out of Scope alignment.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Dent pilot seed lives inside migration 030 (interview Q8 — Q chose migration over manual Dashboard seed)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q's explicit choice in interview: post-deploy smoke (Pilot Smoke S7) finds the config already present, no manual operator step. Idempotent: only writes when slug not already in campaigns[]; tenants other than 18173130 untouched. Schema/data co-mingling is bounded to this single Dent-specific seed and matches the wider 'pilot config land in migrations' pattern (e.g. 023 video_provider seeded NULL via DEFAULT).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ7 may flag schema+data mix; the Dent seed is the explicit Q-authorised exception. Idempotency check via jsonb_path_exists prevents drift on re-run.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Single-flight CT-safe cache pattern in resolver: factory uses CancellationToken.None; per-caller WaitAsync(ct)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Lessons 2026-04-21 FEAT-TFM iter 3 CQ6+Q3 FAIL: GetOrAdd factory with caller's CT poisons joined awaiters. Same pattern reused verbatim from DbTenantFieldMappingResolver.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ6 Performance gate PASS — the underlying Npgsql timeout bounds the fetch; caller cancel is per-await isolated.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: INV-BE-118..121 (4 codes) instead of roadmap's INV-BE-118..120 (3 codes)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Validator/window/reserved-slug fit 118/119/120; INV-BE-121 added for tenant_settings.campaign_config DB transient (NpgsqlException) so dashboards can isolate campaign-config storage outages from generic INV-BE-001 (FEAT-TFM precedent: INV-BE-110 plays the same role for field_mapping).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: 4 codes registered in errors.md + ErrorCodes.cs. Roadmap 'INV-BE-118..120' was a minimum; INV-BE-121 is forward-compat with TFM-style transient classification.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Marketing csproj already has Invekto.Shared reference; no new package adds for FEAT-MCC
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Marketing only consumes Shared.Contracts.Campaigns + Shared.Logging types; both are already in the existing ProjectReference scope. Marketing additionally needed builder.Services.AddMemoryCache() — which it didn't have before — because DbTenantCampaignResolver depends on IMemoryCache.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Marketing Program.cs gains AddMemoryCache(); no other package or csproj change.

verification_questions.question: Does the migration 030 idempotency branch correctly preserve a tenant's pre-existing campaigns[] when re-running while the seed slug is absent? Trace: existing campaigns[] read → seed slug not in jsonb_path_exists → COALESCE(existing -> 'campaigns', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(seed_payload) appends without overwriting.

Does the cross-tenant defensive 403 in TenantCampaignConfigEndpoints PUT correctly fire BEFORE validation/upsert when body.tenant_id mismatches JWT? Confirm the early-return order (TenantContext → body parse → cross-tenant check → validator → resolver Invalidate).

Does CampaignTemplateApplier.ApplyAsync correctly short-circuit (NoOp) when text contains no {{campaign.X}} tokens, preserving existing campaign-agnostic outbound traffic? Confirm matches.Count == 0 → CampaignApplyResult.NoOp(text) returned with ShouldSkip=false.

Does FollowupStageJob.ExecuteAsync window guard correctly bypass for tenants with empty campaigns[] (no MCC adoption)? Confirm 'if (campaignConfig.Campaigns.Count > 0)' check skips the IsWithinWindowAsync call entirely so existing EFS pilots without campaign config keep firing.

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Resolver fall-through (NpgsqlException → empty config) is documented + logged at WARN with INV-BE-121; window guard becomes no-op, but campaign-bound messages with placeholders will still observe inWindow=false and be dropped (operator visible via INV-BE-119 log). Pilot Smoke S7 explicitly tests both substitution and guard activation.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operator wants to launch a roadshow but doesn't know if their config is currently active or how the customer will see {{campaign.cities_human}}.
aha_moments.suggestion: Add a 'Live Preview' card under the editor that resolves placeholders against the current config and shows the rendered text + window status (Aktif / Henüz başlamadı / Sona erdi) per campaign.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator types a slug and sees the customer-facing 'Dublin ve Cork — 14 Mart' immediately, knowing exactly what will be sent before any traffic flows.

aha_moments.user_pain: Cross-instance cache lag (5dk) means Backend operator updates the config but Automation/Marketing instances keep substituting the old cities for up to 5 minutes after PUT.
aha_moments.suggestion: Add a Backend-broadcast endpoint /api/internal/campaign-config/invalidate-broadcast that uses InternalServices:SharedSecret to call peer Automation + Marketing /api/internal/campaign-config/invalidate routes (mirroring FEAT-TFM-CACHE backlog pattern). Push-only, no NOTIFY/LISTEN dependency.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator hits Save → resolves on every instance within 1 second → next dispatched message uses fresh config.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operator needs to type out city slugs (dublin, cork, ...) and remember IANA timezone strings — high friction for non-technical operators.
aha_moments.suggestion: City slug autoderived from name (lowercase + ascii fold + spaces→underscores); timezone autodetected from country (IE→Europe/Dublin, TR→Europe/Istanbul) via a small client-side lookup table.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator types 'Dublin' into name, slug field auto-fills 'dublin' and timezone 'Europe/Dublin' — saves 30 seconds + zero typos per city.

aha_moments.user_pain: Customer complains 'I got an SMS about a roadshow that doesn't exist' — support has no way to trace which campaign+window the dispatch was bound to.
aha_moments.suggestion: Persist a per-dispatch audit row campaign_dispatch_log (tenant_id, lead_id, campaign_slug, rendered_text, sent_at, window_at_dispatch JSON snapshot) so support can SELECT and replay the exact context of a complained message.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support pastes the customer's complaint + phone, gets back the exact campaign slug + cities + dates that the message rendered with at the moment of dispatch.

aha_moments.user_pain: Sales onboarding a new tenant for a multi-city tour wants to demo the full flow but has to manually wire up the config + a flow that uses placeholders.
aha_moments.suggestion: Add a one-click 'Roadshow Template' button on the editor that seeds (a) a sample campaign with 3 mock cities + dates and (b) a paired chatbot flow that uses {{campaign.cities_human}} + {{campaign.event_date}} so the prospect sees end-to-end behaviour in 30 seconds.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Prospect demoing the platform clicks one button, sends a test message to themselves, sees the rendered roadshow text on their phone — 'we can launch this for our 8-city Q3 tour next week'.
